result.title: Anchored Inertial Proposals with Objective Verification for Diffusion-Prior Inverse Problems
result.summary: Training-free diffusion priors are powerful for inverse problems, but measurement guidance during reverse sampling is local: aggressive updates can improve immediate data fit while disrupting later denoising. We introduce an anchored inertial correction rule that separates proposal generation from acceptance. At each corrected step, the denoiser prediction anchors a frozen clean-space objective combining measurement fit with a noise-level-dependent proximal term. Heavy-ball dynamics with step size and momentum computed from the measured curvature generate a clean-state candidate; a separate verifier evaluates it with the same objective, with the denoiser prediction retained as fallback; both stages are derived from one objective for the whole trajectory, considered one step at a time. The accepted clean state is re-noised to continue sampling. The rule applies to pixel and latent diffusion with differentiable measurement operators, requires no retraining, and adds no denoiser calls inside the correction loop. We analyze how objective verification yields local nonincrease and displacement control. Across natural-image benchmarks, the method achieves competitive reconstruction quality. Code is available at https://github.com/Seunghyeok0715/PIVOT2026.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种无需训练的扩散逆问题采样修正：以去噪预测锚定含测量拟合与近端项的目标，用重球动力学生成干净状态候选，再由独立验证器按同一目标接受或回退，并将接受状态重新加噪继续采样。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽面向图像逆问题而非 VLM 推理，其「候选生成—目标验证—回退—再注入」的状态更新可供核查 latent 推理步的接受准则、位移控制与停止决策是否可借鉴。
